name: white-glove
description: ProviderSoft → HHA automation on AWS Lambda

scripts.build: npm run build -w @white-glove/shared && npm run build -w @white-glove/hha-client && npm run build -w @white-glove/tms-db && npm run build -w @white-glove/tms-api && npm run build -w @white-glove/processors && npm run build -w @white-glove/providersoft-bot && npm run build -w @white-glove/infra
scripts.test: npm run test -w @white-glove/shared && npm run test -w @white-glove/hha-client && npm run test -w @white-glove/tms-db && npm run test -w @white-glove/tms-api && npm run test -w @white-glove/processors && npm run test -w @white-glove/providersoft-bot
scripts.sandbox:workflow: npm run build -w @white-glove/shared -w @white-glove/hha-client -w @white-glove/processors && npx --prefix packages/hha-client tsx packages/processors/scripts/sandbox-full-workflow.ts
scripts.sandbox:fixture-workflow: npm run build -w @white-glove/shared -w @white-glove/hha-client -w @white-glove/processors && npx --prefix packages/processors tsx packages/processors/scripts/sandbox-fixture-workflow.ts
scripts.hha:probe-unscheduled-create: npm run build -w @white-glove/shared -w @white-glove/hha-client && npm run probe:unscheduled-create -w @white-glove/hha-client --
